method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 4 of 8 breaks heard

lines.english: O Lord, with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed:

lines.latin: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
lines.english: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.
Have mercy on me, O God,

lines.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto:
lines.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

lines.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
lines.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

lines.latin: Aspérges me, Dómine, hyssópo, et mundábor:
lines.english: Thou shalt sprinkle me, O Lord, with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed:

lines.latin: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
lines.english: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.
